service.name: efinanceAdminPermission
service.description: Check whether the current user has EFINANCE_ADMIN permission

service.name: efinanceCustomerPermission
service.description: Check whether the current user has EFINANCE_CUSTOMER or EFINANCE_ADMIN permission

service.name: efRegisterMember
service.description: Register a new portal member. Creates Party, UserLogin and EfMember.

service.name: efVerifyEmail
service.description: Verify the member's email address with the OTP token.

service.name: efLogin
service.description: Authenticate a portal member. Returns JWT access token and refresh token, or MFA challenge.

service.name: efVerifyMfa
service.description: Complete MFA verification and obtain tokens.

service.name: efReauthenticate
service.description: Issue a short-lived one-time token for a sensitive operation.

service.name: efRefreshToken
service.description: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token.

service.name: efLogout
service.description: Revoke the specified access/refresh token (logout from current device).

service.name: efLogoutAll
service.description: Revoke all active tokens for the authenticated member (logout from all devices).

service.name: efRequestPasswordReset
service.description: Generate a password-reset OTP and send it (stub: stored in DB).

service.name: efResetPassword
service.description: Validate password-reset OTP and update the password.

service.name: efGetProfile
service.description: Return the authenticated member's profile.

service.name: efAcceptConsent
service.description: Record the member's consent to a consent document.

service.name: efListConsents
service.description: List consents recorded for the authenticated member.

service.name: efListConsentDocuments
service.description: List currently effective consent documents.

service.name: efCreateCorporateAccount
service.description: Create or update a corporate account and its administrator role.

service.name: efAddCorporateUser
service.description: Add or update a corporate member role.

service.name: efUpdateCorporateUser
service.description: Update a corporate member role.

service.name: efListCorporateUsers
service.description: List the members and roles of a corporate account.

service.name: efListCorporateAccounts
service.description: List the corporate accounts of the authenticated member.

service.name: efUpdateServiceRequestStatus
service.description: Staff updates a service request status, assignee, or notes.

service.name: efUnlockMember
service.description: Staff unlocks a locked member account.

service.name: efListAuditLogs
service.description: Staff lists audit logs (read-only, newest first).

service.name: efListProducts
service.description: List published financial products. Authentication not required.

service.name: efGetProduct
service.description: Get a single published financial product by productId.

service.name: efSimulateLoan
service.description: Simulate loan repayment schedule. No authentication required. Result is not saved.

service.name: efSimulateLease
service.description: Simulate lease payment schedule. No authentication required. Result is not saved.

service.name: efGetApplicationForm
service.description: Return the field schema for the given product and application type.

service.name: efCreateDraft
service.description: Create a new application draft.

service.name: efSaveDraft
service.description: Save/update draft step data. Returns validation result for the step.

service.name: efGetDraft
service.description: Get draft data including all steps and attached documents.

service.name: efListDrafts
service.description: List the member's active drafts.

service.name: efWithdrawDraft
service.description: Withdraw (cancel) a draft.

service.name: efUploadDraftDocument
service.description: Upload a document to a draft.

service.name: efDeleteDraftDocument
service.description: Delete a document from a draft.

service.name: efSubmitApplication
service.description: Submit a completed draft as a finance application.

service.name: efStartKyc
service.description: Start a KYC identity check for the logged-in member.

service.name: efUploadKycImage
service.description: Upload a KYC image (ID doc, facial, IC data).

service.name: efSubmitKyc
service.description: Submit the KYC check for review.

service.name: efGetKycStatus
service.description: Get the current status of a KYC check.

service.name: reviewEfKycCheck
service.description: Staff review of a submitted KYC check (VERIFIED/RESUBMIT/REJECTED).

service.name: efIsKycVerified
service.description: Check whether the member (or subject party) has a VERIFIED KYC check.

service.name: efPreScreen
service.description: Run pre-screen checks against draft step data. Returns result hint only (not score/rules).

service.name: efGetApplicationStatus
service.description: Get the customer-facing stage of an application based on finance statuses.

service.name: efListStageEvents
service.description: List the stage-change timeline of an application draft.

service.name: efCreateDocumentRequest
service.description: Staff creates an additional document request for a draft/application.

service.name: efListDocumentRequests
service.description: List document requests for an application draft.

service.name: efSubmitRequestedDocument
service.description: Customer submits a document for a pending document request.

service.name: efGetOffer
service.description: Get the current presented quote (offer) for an application draft.

service.name: efAcceptOffer
service.description: Customer accepts the presented offer (requires re-authentication handled at API layer).

service.name: efStartSigning
service.description: Start the signing session for an accepted offer.

service.name: efCompleteSigning
service.description: Complete signing (click-wrap consent) and create the finance agreement.

service.name: efListDocuments
service.description: List delivered documents for an application draft.

service.name: efDownloadDocument
service.description: Get document metadata and text content (binary streaming via efinance content layer).

service.name: efRequestDirectDebit
service.description: Request a direct debit mandate for the customer's contract.

service.name: efGetDirectDebit
service.description: List the customer's direct debit mandates with masked account numbers.

service.name: efGetPaymentInstructions
service.description: Get the bank transfer destination and installment amounts for a contract.

service.name: efUpdateDirectDebitStatus
service.description: Staff registers or rejects a direct debit mandate.

service.name: efListSupportCases
service.description: List the customer's own support cases through the efinance gateway.

service.name: efCreateSupportCase
service.description: Create a support case for the authenticated customer.

service.name: efGetSupportCase
service.description: Get one of the customer's own support cases.

service.name: efReplySupportCase
service.description: Reply to one of the customer's own support cases.

service.name: efCloseSupportCase
service.description: Close or withdraw one of the customer's own support cases.

service.name: efRateSupportCase
service.description: Rate one of the customer's own resolved support cases.

service.name: efGetSupportFormOptions
service.description: Get the customer's contracts, products, applications and case types for support.

service.name: efUploadSupportAttachment
service.description: Upload an attachment to a customer-visible support message.

service.name: efListApplications
service.description: List the member's submitted applications.

service.name: efListContracts
service.description: List the member's loan and lease contracts.

service.name: efGetContract
service.description: Get contract details, repayment schedule, and balance.

service.name: efSimulatePrepayment
service.description: Simulate prepayment (loan only). Returns estimated fees and remaining schedule.

service.name: efRequestPrepayment
service.description: Submit a prepayment request (creates EfServiceRequest, staff executes).

service.name: efRequestModification
service.description: Request loan condition modification (rate/term change consultation).

service.name: efRequestExpiryOption
service.description: Request lease expiry option (return/re-lease/purchase).

service.name: efRequestProfileChange
service.description: Request address/contact/employer change. Creates EfServiceRequest.

service.name: efRequestCertificate
service.description: Request a balance/payment certificate for a contract.

service.name: efListMessages
service.description: List messages (CommunicationEvents) for the member.

service.name: efSendMessage
service.description: Send a message (creates a CommunicationEvent linked to an application/contract).

service.name: efGetNotificationSettings
service.description: Get notification settings for the member.

service.name: efUpdateNotificationSettings
service.description: Update notification settings for the member.
